subject: Taxes
title: State Tax Incentive Wars
description: A short lesson to help you apply State Tax Incentive Wars.

hook.text: When Amazon searched for its HQ2, 238 cities offered billions in tax incentives. New York offered $3 billion.

buildup.text: States compete by offering property tax breaks, income tax credits, and infrastructure subsidies.

discovery.text: Studies show that 80–90% of incentive deals don't change company decisions.

twist.text: Amazon chose New York, then withdrew after public backlash. It went to Virginia—which offered far less.

climax.text: State tax incentive wars transfer wealth from taxpayers to corporations.

punchline.text: 238 cities bid, $3 billion offered. Amazon picked Virginia for less.

quiz.question: What do studies show about corporate tax incentives?
